page.overview:
What is Damage, Inc.?

Damage, Inc. is the final track on Metallica's third album Master of Puppets.

"Damage, Inc." is simply about senseless violence and destruction. It is the only song on the whole Master of Puppets album which contains profane language and is the last song to have all four members given writing credit during the Burton era. "Damage, Inc." and "Leper Messiah" are the only tracks from the album that aren't playable in the video game Guitar Hero: Metallica.

Dealing out the agony within Charging hard and no one's going to give in Living on your knees, conformity Or dying on your feet for honesty Inbred, our bodies work as one Bloody, but never cry submission Following our instinct, not a trend Go against the grain until the end

Blood will follow blood Dying time is here Damage, Incorporated
